context: Tests whether camera configuration and session state changes are serialized with balanced transactions and correct UI boundaries.

checklist.name: Single owner
checklist.description: Assigns AVCaptureSession configuration, startRunning, and stopRunning to one dedicated non-main serial executor or queue.

checklist.name: No detached race
checklist.description: Does not mix main-actor configuration with detached or unrelated-queue start and stop operations.

checklist.name: Balanced transaction
checklist.description: Guarantees every beginConfiguration call reaches commitConfiguration, including early error paths.

checklist.name: Graph checks
checklist.description: Checks canAddInput and canAddOutput before changing the capture graph.

checklist.name: Permission ordering
checklist.description: Resolves camera authorization before entering the session configuration transaction.

checklist.name: Preview boundary
checklist.description: Keeps session ownership in a controller and limits UIViewRepresentable to displaying the AVCaptureVideoPreviewLayer.
